search: US controls work at three levels. Hardware rules set performance thresholds for chips and chip-making equipment that need a licence to ship to China and other listed destinations; the H20 and H200 decisions sit here. Entity rules add named companies to the Entity List, cutting them off from US technology regardless of chip type. Model rules, rarely used until 2026, restrict access to model weights or to a model itself; the Fable 5 order is the first case we know of in which a commercially launched frontier model was withdrawn. Each level is easier to announce than to enforce: smuggling, overseas data centres and remote cloud access all weaken hardware controls, and published open weights cannot be recalled.
